description: A voltage-controlled amplifier: one gain knob, one CV input, one signal path

params.text: Multiplies the signal by 0 to 2, unity in the middle of its travel; the tooltip reads the gain in dB

inputs.text: Adds to the gain at a fifth of a unit per volt, with the knob-plus-input total clamped between 0 and 2

outputs.text: The signal multiplied by the gain

notes: the lamp lights while the input is above 10V.
the knob draws a gold arc from its own position round to where the CV input has moved it, and the arc turns orange when the CV pushes the gain past 0 or 2.

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 2V.
